items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Gimp was his name. Gimp, that was Ruth Etting's husband.

ctx.x: Running the car, I don't know whether he was jealous or what his story was, looked like a frame-up. I forget -- Gimp was his name. Gimp, that was Ruth Etting's husband.
But anyway we were coming downtown to do the show and we're downtown, I said to Harry Leroy, "How's it going, Harry?"
